answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding identity to a physical acoustic signal: each node inverts ray-path travel times into a sound-speed profile, and only a profile matching a registered relic of its prior tomographic history earns standing. At each summit of consensus, peers cross-validate these profiles against internal solitary wave dissipation kinetics, so. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
